about: AITCO Fix malware indicators. Facts only - names, SHA-256 hashes and the start-up places a name counts in. No sample is kept anywhere. Raise 'version' at every change; PCs never take an older list.

indicators.name: EICAR-Test-File
indicators.note: The standard, harmless antivirus test file: the self-test of the check (Defender also quarantines it).

indicators.name: XMRig miner
indicators.note: XMRig is an open-source Monero miner; started by itself on a company PC it is almost always a planted miner.
